name: Weak-day mega grid, exit 12:00
why: A weak close forces de-risking (vol-targeting funds, margin, stops); dealers and dip buyers absorb it and the next session mean-reverts, most in fearful (high VIX) regimes where forced selling overshoots. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_mega_grid.md).
